documentation.description: Fast open typed-decision profile for text decisions; noul/choice/score answers with probabilities in milliseconds. An alias for the current Fast version (see model_version in every response and the S1-Model-Version header); pin s1-fast-1 or s1-fast-2 to stay on one version. Inputs the current version cannot take (several questions, very long input) are answered by s1-fast-1.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
documentation.example_input: {"model":"decisionmodelsio/s1-fast","state":"Mia owns a red bicycle.","questions":{"color":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Which color is the bicycle?","criteria":{"red":null,"blue":null}}}}

documentation.description: Larger open typed-decision profile for text decisions; noul/choice/score answers with probabilities. An alias for the current Pro version: since 12 October 2026 s1-pro-3, based on vLLM-SR d3 26B (Apache-2.0), served in FP8 (see model_version in every response and the S1-Model-Version header). Pin s1-pro-3, or s1-pro-2 (the previous version, Perplexity Decider v1.1, available until at least 11 November 2026), to stay on one version. Text only; up to 3 questions per request, at most 8,192 input tokens per question including the state.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
documentation.example_input: {"model":"decisionmodelsio/s1-pro","state":"Mia owns a red bicycle.","questions":{"color":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Which color is the bicycle?","criteria":{"red":null,"blue":null}}}}

documentation.description: Image + text typed-decision profile: one image plus state, noul/choice/score answers with probabilities. Requests that contain an image are billed at the image_requests rate. An alias for the current Vision version (see model_version in every response and the S1-Model-Version header); pin s1-vision-1 or s1-vision-2 to stay on one version.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming. This model is not currently routable through TrustedRouter: decision-image-pricing-unsupported.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.

documentation.description: Fixed-schema routing classifier for LLM auto-routers: answers category, difficulty, stakes and four routing flags for one request in a single CPU pass (~26 ms). Not a general typed-decision model.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming. This model is not currently routable through TrustedRouter: decision-fixed-questions-unsupported.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
